portfolio_margin_enabled.meaning: Portfolio Margin is activated on the Vault's L1 account

auto_borrow_active.meaning: HyperLiquid PM auto-borrow has triggered on the Vault's L1 account due to adverse price movement

borrow_value.meaning: 0x811 borrow.value of the Vault's L1 account, the borrow leg amount (+X)

total_backing_signed.meaning: totalBackingSigned() value reported by the Accountant
total_backing_signed.checkpoint: after auto-borrow, when surplus is computed

real_net_assets.meaning: real net assets of the Vault's L1 account, unchanged by the auto-borrow
real_net_assets.checkpoint: after auto-borrow, when surplus is computed

assumptions: The borrow leg amount is positive (borrow_value > 0) when auto-borrow triggers, so overstatement by exactly the borrow amount is meaningful.
real_net_assets is the report's real net assets of the L1 account, unchanged by the auto-borrow.
total_backing_signed is the Accountant's reported backing used to compute surplus.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of real_net_assets or total_backing_signed beyond the qualitative statement that backing is overstated by exactly the borrow amount; the exact relation total_backing_signed = real_net_assets + borrow_value is stated in prose but not as a numeric formula with operands.

limitations: The plan formalizes only the backing_overstated impact; phantom surplus, principal displacement, and gate bypass are handled in separate passes.
Exact numeric value X of the borrow amount is not specified; symbols remain symbolic.
The equality total_backing_signed = real_net_assets + borrow_value is captured only as the safety relation total_backing_signed <= real_net_assets, not as an exact overstatement equation.
